protocol: Single UE 5.4 NullRHI process, fixed 60 Hz, 1800 samples with the original 16 m x 10 m display ground.
failure_reason: The passive Manny left the finite display ground during the 30-second run, so later samples no longer represented bounded contact physics. Timing values were not accepted as formal evidence.
resolution: Only performance mode now uses a 200 m x 200 m ground. Three fresh isolated processes replaced this trial; control, impulse and rigid-body parameters were unchanged.
